label: Weapon delivery
description: How a shot reaches its target.

terms.label: Hitscan
terms.description: Hits instantly along the line of fire.

terms.label: Projectile
terms.description: A visible shot with travel time that can be dodged.

terms.label: Beam
terms.description: A continuous beam held on the target; the effect builds while it stays on.

terms.label: Lobbed
terms.description: Arcs over cover onto a ground point; travel time and a minimum range.

terms.label: Lock-on
terms.description: Hold on a target to lock, then fire homing shots; the target gets a warning.

terms.label: Melee
terms.description: Strikes or lunges at touching distance.

terms.label: Attach
terms.description: Works by latching onto or getting inside the target.

terms.label: Place
terms.description: Sets down charges, mines or devices on the ground or a target.

terms.label: Drop
terms.description: Released below or just ahead of the unit; you aim by flying over the target. It falls to the ground, so it never hits fliers.

terms.label: Ram / kamikaze
terms.description: The unit itself is the weapon: it hits by colliding with or diving into the target, often destroying itself.
